question: Should the package adopt `data-dinkus-project-record-identity="fill"` as a supported public identity-slot contract?
rationale: The implementation is compatibility-preserving, but the new documented hook becomes part of the package's public API and repository policy reserves merge approval to Bobby.

options.title: Adopt the explicit fill contract

options.title: Keep the current slot surface
